HEADLINE
make strategic decisions faster

SUBHEADLINE
For busy startup ceos, meetings are too long, decisions unclear.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps busy startup ceos move from meetings are too long, decisions unclear to make strategic decisions faster.

WHO IT IS FOR
busy startup CEOs

THE PROBLEM
meetings are too long, decisions unclear

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
human summarizers or note-taking apps was not designed for busy startup ceos. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing busy startup ceos to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
identifies key takeaways and action items.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of meeting summary software reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with meeting summary software.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
meeting summary software helps busy startup ceos go from meetings are too long, decisions unclear to make strategic decisions faster.

ONBOARDING
1. Define who meeting summary software is for and the problem it solves.
2. Shape your core message so meeting summary software can tailor output.
3. Generate your first result and refine as you go.

EMPTY STATE
1. No audience defined yet. Start by telling meeting summary software who you're building for.
2. No message saved yet. Build your setup to generate output.
3. No output yet. Generate your first result.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Brain saved. Output ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Build Brain
2. Review Brain
3. Generate Positioning
4. Generate Landing
5. Generate UX
6. Refine Message
7. Compare Outputs
8. Save Brain
